The '''University of Lekua V''' was the foremost [[University/Legends|university]] in the [[Centrality/Legends|Centrality]]. The University's [[Department of Comparative Sapient Species]] was well-known for the audacity of its [[Ottdefa/Legends|Ottdefa]] (or "professor-adventurers"), who would risk everything for the sake of their research.
